verdict.rationale: Datalab's own conversion docs say Marker "handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images," which is only a glancing claim that figures are processed during parsing. Nothing shows how figures or charts are extracted, described, or located. The bounding-box citations in datalab-docs-18 cover structured field extraction, a different capability, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented figure/chart image crops, VLM-generated figure descriptions, per-figure page and bounding-box positions in the output, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, figures and charts are extracted or described (VLM summaries, image crops) with positions traceable back to the source page

citations.quote: Marker handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images.
